`Config.Brand` is the sidebar crest and the wording around it. Everything in it is
plain text except `shield`.

### The monogram shield

**Leave `shield` empty and it follows `Config.Theme`**, so setting `accent`
recolours the crest along with everything else. Set something here when the
shield should be your emblem rather than part of the palette.

The shield is two vertical gradients: a metal frame with the letter on it, over a
darker body. Every line is optional and independent.

| Key | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `metalLight` | Top of the metal, the lit edge |
| `metal` | Middle of the metal — what most people mean by "the shield colour" |
| `metalDeep` | Bottom of the metal, the shadowed edge |
| `bodyLight` | Top of the field the letter sits on |
| `body` | Bottom of it. Both are near-black by default and should stay dark |
| `monogram` | The letter. Unset, it uses the metal gradient; set, it goes flat in that colour |

Keep the three metal shades light to dark in one family. Hex only —
`"#c9992f"` or `"#c93"`; anything else falls back to the theme and is named in
the console.

### Info panels

`Config.InfoPanels` is the four panels behind the sidebar buttons. Keep the lines
short — they render in a small parchment panel.

`store` is only shown when `Config.Store.enabled` is `false`.
